ns2:section.sectionTitle: Vocal Mus in African Am Contxt
ns2:section.sectionText: Beyonce is hot. John Legend can croon. These artists have lifted their signature melody and melisma from the Black experience -- finding inspiration and influence from field hollas, gospel, doo-wop and jazz. In Mus 199 explore the voice in the African American context. Discover its origin and intent, mastery and soul through dialogue, research and performance. Enroll today!
